result.summary: Adds `btck_witness_stack_to_bytes` to the libbitcoinkernel C API to serialize a witness stack into consensus bytes in a single call. It also adds unit test coverage in `test_kernel` for the new serialization function.
result.problem: Callers of libbitcoinkernel who read an entire witness stack using `btck_witness_stack_get_item_at` incur an O(n²) cost. Existing kernel interfaces do not provide an efficient single-call mechanism to retrieve full witness data without introducing custom iterator callbacks.
evidence: PR description: "I agree the O(n²) cost of reading a whole witness with `btck_witness_stack_get_item_at` needs fixing. I'm less sure a new callback type is the best way to do it which #36909 is doing. Instead we could expose the witness's serialized bytes..."
result.scope_notes: Offers an alternative design to open PR #36909 for solving the same O(n²) witness stack access performance problem.
result.card: Adds `btck_witness_stack_to_bytes` to libbitcoinkernel to export the consensus serialization of a full witness stack in a single call. Currently, consumers reading all witness items via `btck_witness_stack_get_item_at` face O(n²) overhead. This PR addresses the issue as an alternative to the callback-based approach in PR #36909, following existing kernel `*_to_bytes` API patterns.

risk.why: Mistakes in exported libbitcoinkernel C API functions or buffer handling would affect downstream library consumers without altering node consensus or validation.
